# Why procurement matters

Most agencies buy AI rather than build it.[^FN01-aaaa] The contract sets the terms, and it is often the only document a vendor reads closely.[^EN01-bbbb]

## Evidence

The survey found that 28% of organisations keep an AI register.[^EN02-cccc] This costs $3.50 per user, roughly ~20 minutes, and @someone said so.
